text: A close, angled view into a square white translucent tray or workspace with raised walls, sitting on a grey benchtop. Inside the tray floor are several small round metal inserts or screw heads (one near each side/corner and one at the front), arranged around the centre. At the centre of the tray sits a small square block, white at its base with a teal/green top surface containing four round wells or recesses in a 2x2 pattern; the wells appear empty. Black-and-white printed fiducial markers are attached to the left and lower-left edges of the tray. Behind the tray are white plastic frame pieces with metal bolts and vertical posts, part of a larger rig.
